project_type: Python FastAPI multi-agent investment analysis system with Jinja2 dashboard
verification_instructions: 1. Run pytest to confirm all 448 tests pass. 2. Verify dashboard imports: python3 -c 'from dashboard.app import app'. 3. Verify CLI: python3 -m augur --version
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Python 3.11 default. No Docker daemon.
contribution_requirements: Direct commit to main. Chinese commit messages. Version bump to 7.8.1. Do not delete existing functionality. Fix source, not tests.
key_patterns: Provider chain pattern (datasources/__init__.py), BaseAgent.analyze pattern in personas/, MarketContext dataclass for data passing, FastAPI endpoints in dashboard/app.py, Jinja2 templates in dashboard/templates/
directory_structure: src/augur/ - core library (data, personas, registry, report, backtest, cli, bots, mcp_server). dashboard/ - FastAPI app + templates + static. scanner/ - standalone scanner module. tests/ - pytest tests. docs/ - documentation. personas/ - YAML custom personas.
